Smoky paprika-dusted devilled eggs.How to make it8 eggs4 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise1 tsp Dijon mustard1 tsp lemon juice1 tsp smoked paprika1 tbsp chives, choppedSimmer the eggs for 9 minutes, then cool them in iced water and peel.Halve the eggs and mash the yolks with the mayo, mustard and lemon juice.Pipe or spoon the filling back into the whites.Dust with paprika and scatter with chives.Cups audition popcorn chickenBeca auditions with Cups. Popcorn chicken and sriracha mayo in paper cups.How to make it500g chicken thigh fillets, cut in small pieces125ml buttermilk100g plain flour50g cornflour1 tsp garlic powder1 tsp smoked paprika750ml vegetable oil, for frying4 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise1 tbsp srirachaSoak the chicken in the buttermilk with a pinch of salt.Mix the flours, garlic powder and paprika and toss the chicken through until coated.Fry in batches in oil at 180°C until golden and cooked through.Stir the sriracha into the mayo and serve the chicken in paper cups with the dip.Spin-the-wheel salted popcornSpin for the category.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Main CourseSabotage burritosBumper throws a burrito at Fat Amy. Big spiced beef burritos.How to make it500g beef mince1 brown onion, diced2 tsp ground cumin2 tsp smoked paprika400g tin black beans, drained200g long-grain rice4 large flour tortillas150g cheddar, grated125g sour cream250ml tomato salsaCook the rice.Brown the mince and onion with the spices, then stir in the beans and a splash of water and simmer.Warm the tortillas and fill each with rice, beef, cheese, sour cream and salsa.Roll up tightly, tucking in the ends, and toast seam side down in a hot pan.Ladies of the '80s pulled pork slidersThe riff-off in the empty pool. Smoky pulled pork in soft rolls.How to make it1.2kg pork shoulder2 tbsp brown sugar2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp garlic powder250ml smoky barbecue sauce125ml apple juice12 soft slider rolls1/4 red cabbage, finely shredded3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise1/2 cup dill pickle slicesRub the pork with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt.Put it in a lidded pot with the apple juice and half the sauce and bake at 150°C until it pulls apart.Shred the pork and toss with the rest of the sauce.Mix the cabbage with the mayo.Fill the rolls with pork, slaw and pickles.DessertFinish-him-like-a-cheesecake cheesecakeFat Amy vows to finish Bumper. Baked New York cheesecake with warm berry sauce.How to make it250g plain sweet biscuits100g butter, melted750g cream cheese, softened200g caster sugar3 eggs200g sour cream1 tsp vanilla extract1 lemon, zested300g frozen mixed berriesCrush the biscuits, mix with the butter and press into a lined 22cm springform tin.Beat the cream cheese and 170g sugar until smooth, then beat in the eggs, sour cream, vanilla and zest.Pour over the base and bake at 150°C until just wobbly in the middle, then cool in the oven with the door ajar.Simmer the berries with the rest of the sugar until saucy and serve warm over slices.To ToastPitch-slapped red cup punchFat Amy promises a pitch-slapping.
